_comment: Single source of truth for files vendored from Telegram for Android.
Only copied, split-out, or substantially adapted Telegram source belongs here.
NativeDo code written from scratch is not listed, even if it follows Telegram-like patterns.
Telegram-shaped vendored files live in :telegram module (package stays org.telegram.*).
Native ports adapted to NativeDo data models live in :app (package io.github.baba983.nativedo.*).
exact     - upstream fidelity is the goal. Drift only for host wiring.
native    - we've already diverged and don't claim Telegram parity.
forced_exact subsystems still apply if listed.
modified is byte-level drift from upstream; package/import/host wiring
still counts as modified and must be documented through port_mode/notes.
These must stay upstream-shaped even on native files (see AGENTS.md).
Lines starting with _comment are ignored by tooling.

files.notes: Browser/menu helpers added for ItemOptions: emptyMotionEvent() copied verbatim from upstream; shakeViewSpring(View,float) is a simplified ObjectAnimator wobble (upstream SpringAnimation + shake id resources not ported) and replaceArrows(...) is a pass-through. BottomSheet support surface added for the exact upstream sheet copy: getViewInset(View) and getNavigationBarThirdButtonsFactor(int) are local safe defaults; isSafeToShow(Context) mirrors the upstream Activity finishing/destroyed guard. updateViewVisibilityAnimated(...) now calls the upstream boolean HideViewAfterAnimation constructor.

NativeDo locale shim for vendored UI: exposes isRTL, getString/formatString/plural/date helpers, formatDuration(int), and a minimal getCurrentLocaleInfo().shortName surface used by PhotoViewer's upstream-shaped PhotoCountView and PhotoPickerPhotoCell accessibility text. Full Telegram locale loading and account-specific i18n pipeline are not ported.

notes: Compile shim, not a port: no Telegram source copied. The local file is a minimal
stub (~150 lines) that matches the upstream public API surface used by ported
animation code. Real behaviour is provided by NativeDo. Kept in the manifest so the
upstream path stays discoverable for diffs and to make the shim-vs-port distinction
explicit. Do not treat as vendored; no upstream field/method shapes are preserved.
Compile shim, not a port: no Telegram source copied. The local file is a minimal
stub (~160 lines) that returns safe defaults for SharedConfig.animationsEnabled()
and SharedConfig.shadowsInSections (the only entry points used by ported UI). The
previous 'port_mode: exact' was wrong — diff is ~1900 lines, not 0. Kept in the
manifest so the upstream path stays discoverable; do not treat as vendored.

files.notes: Browser URL dispatch adapted for NativeDo: real openInExternalBrowser/openInExternalApp/hasAppToOpen/IDN_toUnicode/getBrowserPackageName/isBrowserPackageName/replace/replaceHostname; openInTelegramBrowser uses the current LaunchActivity/BaseFragment ArticleViewer sheet; CustomTabs and Telegram-specific internal routing (isInternalUri/openAsInternalIntent/Telegraph/Tonsite) remain no-op stubs.

Real SAX SVG parser; getBitmap(InputStream) drives Instant View SVG. Copied verbatim from upstream (keeps the Larva Labs / Apache-2.0 header); replaces an 87-line compile stub whose getBitmap(...) returned null and rendered IV SVGs blank. Host-wiring only: none required beyond the verbatim copy (all deps present in :telegram). Real deps DrawingInBackgroundThreadDrawable and wallpaper/WallpaperGiftPatternPosition were vendored verbatim alongside it.

NativeDo Theme subset for vendored UI. Host-wired for CheckBoxBase/BottomSheet/PhotoViewer: added Theme.getServiceMessageColor(), Theme.PAINT_CLEAR, ACTION_BAR_PHOTO_VIEWER_COLOR, ACTION_BAR_PICKER_SELECTOR_COLOR, ACTION_BAR_AUDIO_SELECTOR_COLOR, dialogs_onlineCirclePaint, playPauseAnimator bootstrap, MediaActionDrawable chat_filePath/chat_updatePath/chat_flameIcon/chat_gifIcon bootstrap, AdaptiveRipple.filledRect(...), getSelectorDrawable(boolean, ResourcesProvider), and local safe defaults on MessageDrawable. Full Telegram theme/color-animation pipeline remains unported.

Copied verbatim from pinned upstream. Replaces the earlier NativeDo Dialog-backed subset so sheet container layout, dim/back drawable, swipe-dismiss physics, keyboard/status/navigation-bar handling, and nested ActionBar behavior stay upstream-shaped.

Host wiring only: ArticleViewer.Sheet restore/capture/dismiss fallback adapted for NativeDo ActionBarLayout/BottomSheetTabs lifecycle; drawing/gesture/measurement/animation bodies remain upstream-shaped. WebActionBar.bookmark_item now persists to the local WebBookmarks store (org.telegram.ui.web.WebBookmarks) instead of SendMessagesHelper.sendMessage to Saved-Messages; the bookmarked toast opens BookmarksFragment instead of the Telegram Saved-Messages ChatActivity.

NativeDo topic-detail/ArticleViewer image viewer port: keeps upstream singleton, PageBlocksAdapter, EmptyPhotoViewerProvider, PlaceProviderObject, setParentActivity, openPhoto, closePhoto, and video-player access API shape while keeping URL fallback for Discourse images and preserving Telegram ImageLocation/full-size/thumb/parentObject/progress-key/PageBlock metadata when PageBlocksAdapter supplies TLRPC media. Replaces Telegram's full message/media/editor/stories viewer with an ImageReceiver-backed fullscreen gallery, but the interaction engine is now upstream-shaped for core photo behavior: the PageBlocksAdapter entry path now preserves URL item caption and width/height metadata instead of collapsing blocks to plain URLs, builds UrlPhotoItem from Telegram media ImageLocation where available, maps the selected index after filtering invalid blocks, keeps the active PageBlocksAdapter for the viewer session, calls updateSlideshowCell(currentPageBlock) during initial image setup and index switches like upstream ArticleViewer/PhotoViewer, exposes EmptyPhotoViewerProvider.willSwitchFromPhoto(...) and calls it before currentIndex changes so NativeDo cells can unhide the previous source before onPhotoChanged hides the new source, exposes EmptyPhotoViewerProvider.getThumbForPhoto(...) like upstream and uses it as a ClippingImageView animation bitmap fallback when the PlaceProviderObject/source ImageReceiver cannot provide a usable holder, left/center/right ImageReceivers preload adjacent media using Telegram ImageLocation/thumb data with URL fallback, set crossfadeAlpha=2 like upstream, share an upstream-shaped delegate so side-image loads also refresh bounds, center image loading is raised to FileLoader.PRIORITY_HIGH, horizontal swipes draw side images and switch index after slide animation, velocity and distance thresholds trigger next/previous, GroupedPhotosListView.setMoveProgress is synchronized during drag, side-image page reveal now mirrors Telegram's asymmetric drawing treatment by scaling/fading the right image in when moving to next and scaling/fading the center image down when exposing the previous image, and grouped PageBlock galleries with nonzero groupId now route through GroupedPhotosListView's upstream PageBlock grouping branch while ordinary URL galleries continue using the full ImageLocation strip. Double-tap zoom targets 3.0x, pinch/pan use min/max bounds with elastic edge resistance and release settle, edge-tap page navigation uses upstream GestureDetector2 onDown/onUp pressed-state timing and canDoubleTap suppression so side taps do not get swallowed by zoom gestures, base-scale vertical drag-to-dismiss fades the BackgroundDrawable and springs back or closes by threshold/velocity, tap toggles counter/close/bottom-strip chrome through upstream GestureDetector2, and the focusable windowView intercepts Back through dispatchKeyEvent/dispatchKeyEventPreIme to close the overlay like upstream. Container structure now mirrors the upstream layering more closely with a WindowManager overlay, BackgroundDrawable on windowView, SizeNotifierFrameLayoutPhoto/FrameLayoutDrawer-style photo drawing container, overlay chrome, PhotoViewerActionBarContainer title/subtitle layer, upstream ACTION_BAR_PHOTO_VIEWER_COLOR top bar, upstream-shaped ActionBarMenu more button backed by URL-only share/copy/open actions, upstream-shaped bottomLayout container retained for future picker/editor chrome but hidden for ordinary URL photo viewing so it does not leave a non-Telegram empty 48dp black bar, WindowManager-level navigationBar scrim sibling, GroupedPhotosListView with upstream dp(10) top padding, read-only CaptionTextViewSwitcher plus upstream-shaped CaptionScrollView/NestedScrollView caption layer, and a separate ClippingImageView for place-backed open/close transitions. Opening/closing uses the NativeDo provider bridge for URL-keyed source bounds/source ImageReceiver/source bitmap holders, radius metadata, thumbUrl placeholders, WindowManager overlay host flags, and per-gallery-image provider handoff; source-backed transitions now consume ImageReceiver drawRegion/imageX/imageY orientation and clipping values for Telegram-style ClippingImageView animation and fade chrome without the no-source toolbar/bottom slide translation, no-source open fallback now fades the whole container/background/chrome in like Telegram's object-null pre-draw path instead of fading only the center image, and no-source close fallback now follows Telegram's container scale-to-0.9 plus alpha/background fade instead of sliding the photo off-screen. Control chrome overlays the full-container fitted photo instead of shrinking the image viewport, and core fit/zoom/page/drag-dismiss thresholds now route through upstream-shaped getContainerViewWidth/getContainerViewHeight helpers; PhotoCountView now mirrors upstream's AnimatedFloat show progress, ACTION_BAR_PHOTO_VIEWER_COLOR background, locale-aware 'of' center text, RTL number ordering, and AnimatedTextDrawable left/right number transitions; loading indicators now use Telegram's three-slot PhotoProgressView structure (center/right/left) with circle_big/cancel_big/load_big drawables, arc/progress interpolation, state alpha transitions, side-image scale/alpha coupling during page reveal, and NotificationCenter/ImageLoader file progress events keyed by Telegram attach file names or URL fallback while still omitting Telegram's full FileLoader cancel/download state menu and video state machine; top chrome uses Telegram-style SimpleTextView title buffering plus AnimatedTextView subtitle/right-padding animation without the upstream emoji NotificationCenter observer, and captions now use Telegram's read-only switcher/scrollView coupling, dynamic top-margin calculation, fading-edge background drawing, nested-scroll overscroll consumption, and SpringAnimation settle without the upstream edit/translate/keyboard/text-selection pipeline.
PhotoViewer bottom grouped-photo strip copied verbatim from upstream and fed by NativeDo UrlPhotoItem/ImageLocation data through PhotoViewer's delegate.

Telegram image-view wrapper used by vendored cells and viewer-related UI. NativeDo keeps ImageReceiver-backed loading/drawing API but stubs BackupImageView.blurText because the upstream Text helper is not ported.
Inline ImageReceiver span used by Telegram rich text / instant-view image rendering. Copied verbatim.
Photo/editor support cell copied verbatim from upstream; kept for PhotoViewer/photo-picker API surface compatibility.
Photo picker grid cell copied verbatim from upstream to replace the former NativeDo stub; retained as PhotoViewer/photo-picker/editor support infrastructure.
Photo editor seek bar copied verbatim from upstream and used by PhotoEditToolCell.
PhotoViewer/photo-picker bottom action bar copied verbatim from upstream. Replaces an 18-line compile stub and uses upstream photobadge/bluecounter drawables plus picker/audio selector colors.
Background video-player holder copied verbatim from upstream; retained for ArticleViewer/PhotoViewer-facing video API compatibility.

Copied verbatim. Base class for all Telegram cells; provides RippleDrawableSafe (used by Switch), setDrawableBounds helpers, long-press detection, and RenderNode caching. All deps (SizeNotifierFrameLayout.IViewWithInvalidateCallback, SharedConfig) present in :telegram.
Compile-only stub; full Telegram measurement/drawing not ported.

Verbatim upstream. Used by the WebBrowserSettings search-engine picker dialog (and other radio dialogs). Deps RadioButton/LayoutHelper/Theme/AndroidUtilities/LocaleController are all vendored. Replaces an earlier hand-rolled subset that used android.widget.RadioButton and a no-op setCheckColor.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_SHADOW: keeps upstream setText (double-newline AbsoluteSizeSpan), setFixedSize/getFixedSize, onMeasure fixedSize -1/0/n branches, top/bottom padding, getText/getTextView/setTextGravity/setEnabled. OMITTED: LinkSpanDrawable.LinksTextView (tappable links / emoji) replaced by a plain TextView, so getTextView returns TextView not LinksTextView; key_windowBackgroundWhiteGrayText4 -> key_windowBackgroundWhiteGrayText (key not in local Theme).

NativeDo ArticleTextSelectionHelper port for topic detail: preserves Telegram's ArticleSelectableView/TextLayoutBlock/ArticleTextSelectionHelper API shape, and now keeps an upstream-shaped generic TextSelectionHelper<Cell extends SelectableView> core for selection state / layout hooks / overlay contracts. Includes long-press selection entry, touch-coordinate word selection with one-touch drag continuation after long press, rounded CornerPath selection geometry, ScalablePath line-rect shaping, handle-edge clipping, Telegram-style line-bottom handle anchoring with RTL-aware left/right silhouette switching and overshoot scale-in animation, FloatingActionMode/FloatingToolbar copy/quote/select-all/translate actions with Android/Telegram resource labels and Telegram-style dynamic action visibility, current-locale translate target propagation without copying Telegram's ML Kit source-language detection, copy-to-clipboard callback path, draggable start/end handles with Telegram-style finger-to-endpoint moving offsets, word-boundary snap while dragging, start/end role flip when crossing endpoints, row-aware closest-layout hit testing for table/poll-style same-line text blocks, overlay chrome with upstream-style short-tap/slop guarded empty-area cancel, Android Magnifier support, cursor haptic feedback while dragging, multi-cell drag selection, RecyclerView edge auto-scroll, and selectable visible text from image captions, CodeBlock, OneboxBlock, PollBlock, and TableBlock. Replaces a no-op compile stub.

Compact NativeDo bridge for topic text selection: keeps upstream ActionMode.Callback2 + FloatingToolbar contract, invalidateContentRect/updateViewLocationInWindow/hide/finish lifecycle shape, and now mirrors Telegram's FloatingToolbarVisibilityHelper states for hide requests, moving content rects, out-of-bounds content, and window-focus changes. Still omits NotificationCenter account-scoped reactions and full display/window metric machinery.

NativeDo text-selection toolbar: keeps upstream setMenu/setOnMenuItemClickListener/setContentRect/show/updateLayout/hide/dismiss API used by FloatingActionMode, and now mirrors Telegram's main-panel plus overflow-panel interaction with PopupWindow positioning, show/open animations, 48dp action rows, 12dp rounded toolbar background, localized back-row overflow panel chrome, label-measured overflow width, animated-vector overflow/back arrows from upstream resources, and layout-change relayout while showing. Still omits upstream blur, premium-lock, suggested-width machinery, and full touchable-region plumbing.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_TEXT and cast in WebBrowserSettings.onClick. Keeps upstream public API the adapter/fragments call: setText/setTextAndIcon(res|Drawable)/setTextAndValue/setTextAndValueAndIcon(res|Drawable)/setValue/setColors(icon,text)/getTextView/getImageView, plus the static applyNewSpan. Rendering (icon + title + subtitle + right value, dp(50)/dp(64) height, 68/20 divider inset) ported from the NativeDo UniversalCells.TextCell layout rather than upstream's SimpleTextView/AnimatedTextView path. OMITTED: Switch checkbox, RLottieImageView/RLottieDrawable animation, AnimatedEmojiDrawable sticker values, loading shimmer, SettingsActivity colorful-icon background, FilterCreateActivity.NewSpan (applyNewSpan is pass-through), spoilers value view, RTL mirroring.

Faithful subset used by UniversalAdapter VIEW_TYPE_CHECK and cast in WebBrowserSettings.onClick. Keeps upstream public API the adapter/fragments call: itemId field, setTextAndCheck/setChecked/isChecked/setDivider/setDrawCheckRipple/setHeight/setTypeface/setColors/setEnabled(boolean,List<Animator>), and the setBackgroundColorAnimated radial reveal (CubicBezierInterpolator.EASE_OUT, 240ms, ANIMATION_PROGRESS property, lastTouchX-anchored circle) used by the in-app-browser toggle. OMITTED: org.telegram.ui.Components.Switch (available but intentionally replaced by a plain track+thumb SwitchView using key_switchTrack/key_switchTrackChecked; AvatarSpan, RLottieImageView colorful icon, valueTextView multiline/value rows, setBackgroundColorAnimatedReverse, Switch.setOverrideColor crossfade, RTL mirroring.

files.notes: NativeDo subset for the linux.do profile page (no chat / story tappable-link use). Replaces upstream SpoilersTextView/LinkSpanDrawable.LinksTextView with plain TextView and drops the imageView decoration, right-value row, emoji parser, multiline constructors, link long-press / hit-test, and accessibility contentDescription builder. KEPT (still upstream-shaped): setTextAndValue(text, value, divider) 3-arg overload, onMeasure fixed dp(60) + divider, onDraw divider line at dp(20) inset using Theme.getColor(key_divider), and the static UItemFactory inner class bind path. ADDED locally: VIEW_TYPE = 10_002 constant and Factory.isClickable() returning false. OMITTED vs upstream: setTextAndValue(text, value, value2, divider) 4-arg overload, setImage / setImage(d, desc) / hasImage / getImageView / setImageClickListener, setTextWithEmojiAndValue, setContentDescriptionValueFirst, processColor / overrideColor hooks, onTouchEvent link hit-testing, onInitializeAccessibilityNodeInfo, and the 4-arg constructor variants. Padding is 17dp (textView marginLeft/Right, no horizPadding ctor) instead of upstream's 23dp. The previous 'port_mode: exact' was wrong — diff is 276->153 lines with public API trimmed, not zero drift.
NativeDo profile keeps ProfileActivity-style collapsible header, avatar gooey effect, avatar click expansion, title/subtitle layout, and release snap while binding to linux.do session/profile data.

notes: Repurposed DialogCell for Discourse topics. Native Feature, but
measurement and drawing subsystems are still upstream-shaped per
AGENTS.md forced-exact rules.
MovableCell SPI implemented for DialogsItemAnimator: setMoving/setClipProgress/
setTopClip/setBottomClip + clipRect in onDraw mirror DialogCell upstream.
SDK 24 clipRect fallback (drawRect with windowBackgroundWhite) intentionally omitted.
Discourse additions over DialogCell: is_hot badge, like_count in message preview,
tag pills row, excerpt-based message preview, pinned background overlay,
muted-counter gray pill. Row height expands for tags row.

files.notes: NativeDo topic-detail post cell: BaseCell shell, avatar/header/body/reaction/reply drawing, long-press, and hit-testing are shaped after ChatMessageCell while binding to Discourse Post and PostBodyBlock models. Reply footer interaction now follows ChatMessageCell commentButtonRect/checkCommentButtonMotionEvent shape for rect hit testing, selector hotspot updates, click sound, and state clearing; the reply footer avatar stack now follows Telegram comment-button geometry (24dp avatars, first avatar +2dp, subsequent +17dp) and draws reply authors through ImageReceiver with AvatarDrawable initials fallback. Body block geometry also follows ArticleViewer block-cell patterns. Image taps now map block-local image bounds to window rects and pass URL-keyed source-bounds/source-receiver/source-bitmap/source-radius providers through the delegate so PhotoViewer can animate close back to the current visible gallery image, including images reached by horizontal swiping after the initial tap. Long-press selection now starts before CodeBlock/OneboxBlock/PollBlock/TableBlock consume ACTION_DOWN, cancels the active block press once selection mode starts, and forwards the still-active touch stream to TextSelectionHelper so Telegram-style one-touch drag selection continues until finger-up.
NativeDo topic header row with Telegram/ArticleViewer-style title + metadata spacing; binds Discourse topic title, counts, and tags.
Small centered topic footer/retry row following Telegram footer cell spacing while using NativeDo retry/end/empty text.
Shared NativeDo StaticLayout block base derived from ArticleViewer text block measurement/drawing and link hit-testing concepts; uses NativeDo PostBodyTextBuilder and delegate routing.
NativeDo paragraph block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockParagraphCell, backed by TextLayoutBlock.
NativeDo heading block corresponding to ArticleViewer header/subheader cells with local Discourse heading levels.
NativeDo divider block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockDividerCell.

NativeDo image block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockPhotoCell; uses Discourse image URLs and ImageReceiver instead of Telegram page media models. Captions are exposed to TextSelectionHelper, and image taps expose URL-keyed source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off.

NativeDo collage block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockCollageCell; uses Telegram grouped-media-style aspect-ratio row geometry with Discourse lightbox groups and ImageReceiver tiles. Each tile now exposes URL-keyed source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off. Not a full BlockCollageCell.GroupedMessages port yet.

NativeDo Discourse onebox card using ChatMessageCell link-preview measurement/drawing/hit-region ideas without importing MessageObject or TLRPC.WebPage. Text layouts are exposed to TextSelectionHelper, and thumbnail taps expose URL-keyed source bounds/ImageReceiver/radius for PhotoViewer hand-off.

NativeDo quote block derived from ArticleViewer.BlockBlockquoteCell text/bar layout: keeps the upstream 18dp left line, 2dp line width, 14dp text inset, 8dp vertical spacing, separate title/body StaticLayouts, link hit-testing, and now exposes both title and body layouts to TextSelectionHelper. Backend expansion remains NativeDo-specific and routes Discourse data-topic/data-post through TopicViewModel.

NativeDo preformatted code block corresponding to ArticleViewer.BlockPreformattedCell; keeps upstream-shaped rectangular background band from y=dp(8) to height-dp(8), 16dp horizontal text margin, 12dp child vertical margin plus 8dp scroll padding, and horizontal scrolling inside the canvas-drawn block with parent-intercept handoff instead of an actual HorizontalScrollView child. Syntax highlighting remains intentionally omitted per topic-detail plan.

NativeDo ordered/unordered list block corresponding to ArticleViewer list item block cells; keeps Telegram-style measured marker column, first-item top padding, marker/text spacing, and now exposes ordered/unordered markers as TextSelectionHelper copy prefixes so selected list text preserves the visible bullet/number. Nested block-item parity is not claimed.

NativeDo table block derived from ArticleViewer.BlockTableCell/TableLayout geometry concepts: uses intrinsic per-column width measurement, horizontal overflow scrolling, grid drawing, and exposes table cell StaticLayouts to TextSelectionHelper. Full upstream TL_pageTableCell colspan/rowspan TableLayout parity is not claimed.

NativeDo spoiler block derived from Telegram SpoilersTextView/SpoilerEffect reveal model: concealed text is drawn as line-bounded masks with deterministic particle noise and tap-origin ripple reveal. Does not port SpoilerEffect2 media/GL, shader bitmap factory, or TextStyleSpan marker parsing.
Discourse reply row derived from a small ChatMessageCell text/avatar subset.

Copied verbatim. Custom toggle switch with BoolAnimator, BaseCell.RippleDrawableSafe, and themed track/thumb drawing. All deps (AndroidUtilities, Theme, BoolAnimator, BaseCell, CubicBezierInterpolator) present in :telegram.

Minimal EditText compatibility surface required by FragmentSearchField.
Minimal animated visibility helper required by FragmentSearchField.

Copied verbatim from pinned upstream. NativeDo topic sheets now subclass the upstream container and only provide app-owned adapter rows/content.
Compile-only stub for BottomSheet instanceof CameraView checks; no camera behavior ported.
Compile-only stub for BottomSheetWithRecyclerListView theme-description API; no theme description behavior ported.

Compile-only View stub for BottomSheetWithRecyclerListView emoji-popup type checks; no emoji picker behavior ported.

Copied from upstream as a BottomSheetWithRecyclerListView dependency. Host wiring only: removed CachedMediaLayout import/branch because that class is not vendored; nested-scroll handoff and maxTop measurement structure remain upstream-shaped.

Copied verbatim from pinned upstream; now backed by upstream MediaActionDrawable instead of the former empty draw stub.

notes: Added public trimToSize(int) overload for ImageLoader.onLowMemory().

HttpFileTask and HttpImageTask delegate the transfer to it; otherwise the
upstream HttpURLConnection path runs verbatim. Lets :app handle product
concerns (auth cookies, Cloudflare clearance, UA, Referer) via OkHttp
interceptors without leaking that knowledge into vendored code.

Copied verbatim. Thin wrapper over the vendored CheckBoxBase (the previous NativeDo inline rewrite was 206 lines against the upstream 153-line wrapper; merging required vendoring CheckBoxBase too). Drawing/animation bodies live in CheckBoxBase; this class only forwards. Deps (CubicBezierInterpolator, GenericProvider, AndroidUtilities, Theme.ResourcesProvider) are vendored.
Copied verbatim from pinned upstream as SeekBarView timestamp label/marquee support.
NativeDo shim containing only upstream AudioPlayerAlert.ClippingTextViewSwitcher for SeekBarView. The full Telegram audio-player sheet, playlist, cast, and message/download business remain unported.
Replaces the earlier 26-line NativeDo progress-only stub with upstream seekbar behavior used by ArticleViewer and future PhotoViewer audio/video controls.

NativeDo ActionBarMenuItem subset with upstream-shaped PhotoViewer popup menu behavior: disables platform PopupWindow window animations so ActionBarPopupWindow drives open/close timing, enables outside touch/clipping, supports menu X/Y offsets, resets popup scroll before showing, accounts for item translation when anchoring, and applies ActionBarMenuSubItem selector colors through setSelectorColor().

Imports ViewOutlineProviderImpl mirroring upstream's import region but never references it in-body (rounded corners use the 9-patch background + clipPath in dispatchDraw). startAnimation/dispatchDraw/setBackScaleY animation+drawing constants kept upstream-shaped; the onItemShown() child-animation callback is commented out (not present on the NativeDo ActionBarMenuSubItem).

Submenu swipe-back layout used by ActionBarPopupWindow. Outline provider helpers copied verbatim from upstream. ActionBarPopupWindow imports it mirroring upstream's import region, but the popup body does not reference it (rounded corners come from the 9-patch background + clipPath in dispatchDraw); retained to satisfy the mirrored import and stay byte-aligned with upstream.

Full upstream table grid (Axis/Spec column-row solving, onMeasure/onLayout/onDraw, getTextX/getTextY, addChild cell text-layout via TableLayoutDelegate). Copied verbatim; delegates text layout to ArticleViewer.DrawingText and selection to TextSelectionHelper.ArticleTextSelectionHelper. Replaces an earlier 50-line compile stub that rendered Instant View tables blank.
NativeDo keeps a BrowserSheet bridge while restoring upstream WebTabData.props for Browser/WebView tab state migration.
Replaced 309-line native port with full upstream 1346-line copy. Host wiring: DialogCell.FixedWidthSpan replaced with standalone FixedWidthSpan. SpoilerEffect is a no-op stub.

Host wiring: call onOpenedMenu before showing ItemOptions so ArticleViewer can settle scroll/header state.

Minimal native WebView host for ArticleViewer URL loading; WebViewProxy/getProxy, MyWebView.setContainers/evaluateJS/opener, basic webview_ext/webview_share/webview_app_ext injection, low-risk URL/title/favicon/history metadata state, find-in-page search state with destroyed-WebView guards, and preserve/replace WebView rebinds mirror the upstream API surface (resetWebView() clears the field like upstream so a preserved WebView is owned solely by ArticleViewer.CachedWeb; re-attachment is replaceWebView's job in attach(); the WebViewClient/WebChromeClient page-load/title/icon callbacks null-guard that field since a preserved WebView can still fire callbacks after it is cleared), while Telegram bot WebApp event handling remains stubbed.

Backend adapted: BookmarksList now reads from the local WebBookmarks store (BrowserHistory.Entry items) instead of MediaDataController.loadMedia over MTProto; links list retyped MessageObject -> BrowserHistory.Entry; BookmarkView.set(BrowserHistory.Entry,...) gained withArrow/checked params. BookmarksList.load() uses a single WebBookmarks.getAll(callback) population path (callback always fires, synchronously when already loaded) to avoid the prior dual sync/async branch race. Rendering/measurement/drawing unchanged.

Backend adapted: list/selection retyped MessageObject -> BrowserHistory.Entry over the local WebBookmarks store; multi-select delete removes from WebBookmarks instead of MessagesController.deleteMessages (a Telegram stub); 'go to message' (Saved-Messages ChatActivity) is a no-op with its action-mode item hidden. Layout unchanged.

Outer class (bot WebView attachment layout) stripped to a stub; inner classes WebViewSwipeContainer and WebProgressView preserved in upstream structure. Host wiring: setWebView accepts base WebView (works with both MyWebView and standard WebView), allowingScroll uses instanceof MyWebView check for injectedJS, topActionBarOffsetY default uses ActionBar.getCurrentActionBarHeight(), Bulletin.getVisibleBulletin() returns null (no-op path).

Small NativeDo universal cells derived from Telegram settings/browser list cell patterns rather than a one-to-one upstream file copy.

Small NativeDo UniversalAdapter (no listView/dialog/sections/reorder/chart surface). The 5 built-in view types now create and bind the real upstream cells exactly as upstream does, so fragment casts succeed and styling matches Telegram: VIEW_TYPE_HEADER -> HeaderCell.setText; VIEW_TYPE_GRAY_SECTION -> GraySectionCell.setText/setRightText (non-section variant; this adapter has no listView.hasSections()); VIEW_TYPE_TEXT -> TextCell.setText/setTextAndIcon/setTextAndValue(AndIcon) + accent/red/default setColors; VIEW_TYPE_CHECK -> TextCheckCell.setTextAndCheck/itemId/setChecked (setDrawCheckRipple(true) at create, since asRippleCheck collapses to VIEW_TYPE_CHECK locally); VIEW_TYPE_SHADOW -> TextInfoPrivacyCell.setFixedSize/setText + greydivider* background via Theme.getThemedDrawable. The custom/factory view types (UItemFactory, BookmarkCell, WebsiteCell, SettingCell, InfoCell, SpaceCell, RadioCell, flicker, space) still use UniversalCells. OMITTED vs upstream shadow bind: asCenterShadow centered-text (HintView2.cutInFancyHalf), listView.hasSections() clearing, field_carret_empty no-neighbour placeholder (resource not vendored -> transparent), dialog-mode layering.
